data.title: Fun with Lengths!
data.description: Compare different objects to find out which one is longer or shorter.

challenges.instruction: Look at the crayon and the toothbrush. Which one is longer?
challenges.hint: Check which object reaches further across the grid lines.
challenges.narration: Let's compare a crayon and a toothbrush. Which one is longer?

challenges.instruction: Look at the paintbrush and the crayon. Which one is longer?
challenges.hint: Look at both ends. Which bar stretches out further?
challenges.narration: Now let's look at a paintbrush and a crayon. Can you find the longer one?

challenges.instruction: Look at the pencil and the paintbrush. Which one is longer?
challenges.hint: Compare the two bars side by side on the grid.
challenges.narration: Here is a pencil and a paintbrush. Which object is longer?
